changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for personal injury compensation calculation.
- Provides step-by-step guidelines for calculating various compensation items (injury, death, disability, funeral expenses, lost income, nursing, etc.) under current Chinese rules.
- Strongly enforces the use of the included Python script (`scripts/personal_injury_compensation.py`) for all monetary calculations; manual or model-based calculations are not allowed.
- Supports supplementary data input (`statistics_overrides`) for missing local statistical data.
- Detailed rules for data collection, script execution, and error handling included.
- Clear instructions on generating structured output in Markdown, JSON, and Excel formats.
